import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(0, end='')
        return
    costs = []
    ec = 0
    oc = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            ec += 1
        else:
            oc += 1
        if ec > 0 and oc > 0 and ec == oc:
            if i + 1 < n:
                costs.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))
    if not costs:
        print(0, end='')
        return
    elif len(costs) == 1:
        print(1 if costs[0] <= b else 0, end='')
        return
    else:
        costs.sort()
        k = 0
        for cost in costs:
            if b >= cost:
                b -= cost
                k += 1
            else:
                break
        print(k, end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
